svg.text: Condition editor — the Expert view, redesigned (house style; DESIGN_Condition_Editor.md §8)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
Expert — every field of the condition
What changed against today's measured frame:
② the kind is the node's own row
chevron · coloured glyph · name, its kind
a binding shows only where one exists,
'Objective: Hold the bridge', picked on the
map or from a list — not 'Exact · Key #10'
⑤ numbers as people write them
'no limit' / 'no end' for the open bound
⑥ a collapsed node says what it means
its sentence, from the ONE sentence renderer
'Add condition' at the list's end; a trash
⑧ the When tab holds the condition
and its timing — the rule's title, scoring
①②③⑤⑥⑦ are fixes to the ONE struct editor — every raw
inspector, params form, replay search and breakpoint gets
them. ④ and the names are data on the condition types.
